*** A STUNNING, EXTENDED FOUR/FIVE BEDROOM (FULL ATTIC CONVERSION, DOUBLE BEDROOM AND EN-SUITE BATHROOM), FAMILY HOME, PRIME LOCATION ON "BANCROFT", VERY SPACIOUS HIGH-SPEC LIVING ACCOMMODATION OF 1,900 SQ FT, WALKING DISTANCE TO TALLAGHT VILLAGE, THE SQUARE SHOPPING CENTRE AND TALLAGHT LUAS, TURN-KEY CONDITION THROUGHOUT, BEAUTIFUL REAR GARDEN AND OFF-STREET DRIVEWAY PARKING***

Byrne Malone Estate Agents are thrilled to present 84 Bancroft Park to the market. This stunning four/five bedroom, extended family home has been the subject of huge improvements by the current owners and comes to the market in turn-key condition throughout. This fabulous property which benefits from a full attic conversion (double bedroom with en-suite bathroom) and a full width front extension has been finished with style and flair to the very highest specifications and offers bright and very spacious living accommodation of 176m2.

To the ground floor is a lovely sitting room that opens onto the beautiful rear garden, a second reception room (TV room/games room), a superb open plan kitchen/dining room and a storage room. 

To the first floor are four bedrooms with en-suite to main bedroom and a family bathroom. The top floor attic conversion offers a large double bedroom with an en-suite bathroom.

To the rear is a beautifully manicured garden with lawn, bespoke paved patio and raised deck area and to the front a large cobble-lock driveway providing off-street parking for two cars.

Properties of this calibre rarely come to the market and an internal inspection comes highly recommended.

To view this exceptional home please call us on 01 912 5500
